rules.description: Verify MaxDate is within 1 year and values are non-negative (and within [0, 100] for unemployment rates) for monthly ABS Labour Force series

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(UnemploymentRate_|dc/nm9hcklgg5zb3|Count_Person_(Employed|Unemployed))')
params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1) AND total_svs >= 9 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0 AND (NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '^UnemploymentRate_') OR MaxValue <= 100)

rules.description: Verify MaxDate is within allowable publication lag and values are non-negative for annual Estimated Resident Population and 3-year Period Life Expectancy series

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '^LifeExpectancy_') OR (regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person') AND NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '(Condition|Employed|Unemployed)'))
params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND total_svs >= 250 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0

rules.description: Verify MaxDate and non-negative values for 5-year Census health conditions and biennial household income survey series

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '(Condition|^Weekly_)')
params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 2016 AND total_svs >= 580 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0
